provider: beehiiv (free plan) — 500 MB per podcast episode, newsletter attachment host

free_tier.stated: Free plan is "Free forever" with unlimited email sends (pricing page). Per-file: "The maximum file size for a single podcast episode upload is 500 MB." File blocks in posts allow attachments; images must be under 5 MB.

per_object_cap.stated: maximum file size for a single podcast episode upload is 500 MB

egress.terms: CDN-served post media; no egress billing on the free plan.

tooling: REST API exists (beehiiv API + Zapier integration, v3 app). No rclone backend.
chaining: Episodes are per-show; multiple shows × multiple publications per account. But 500 MB × episodes is a podcasting quota, not a blob store, and the free plan's real limit is subscriber count (2,500), not bytes.

limits.value: maximum file size for a single podcast episode upload is 500 MB

limits_note: per-object-cap 500 MB podcast audio, 5 MB images, 1 MB fonts. Email body itself is capped at Gmail's 102 KB clipping threshold, so the attachment is the only real payload path. No published aggregate byte quota on free.
reliability_note: Media re-encoding risk must be assumed for audio/video paths; original-byte retrieval is not documented. Treat as CDN surface, not storage.
confidence_note: Re-read on 2026-11-03 from vendor pages: https://www.beehiiv.com/support/article/41323776364823 (500 MB maximum for a single podcast episode upload) and https://www.beehiiv.com/pricing (Free includes up to 2,500 subscribers; every plan includes unlimited email sends). The per-object cap that binds the verdict cites a vendor capture; the image, font and email-clipping limits stay unverified.
